proposedRules: Z1: preserve the product goal and choose the smallest relevant tests, avoid CI repetition without meaningful SHA or dependency change
Z2: before private GitHub-hosted jobs, check account-wide free allocation and billing gate; unknown or exhausted = BLOCKED; never auto-pay
Z3: run Node, Python, Playwright, build and local app smoke natively on Windows without invoking GitHub Actions where suitable
Z4: App-manager must not run arbitrary repository commands, privileged shells, untrusted PRs or third-party code; require approved allow-list and non-admin isolation
Z5: self-hosted Actions runner requires reviewed isolated disposable environment; not authorized as a cost-saving shortcut
Z6: signed Xcode/macOS, RU03, App Group, real device, human reviews, QA, Production and publication gates remain unchanged
Z7: on failed billing/runner provisioning, stop retries and record BLOCKED_NOT_EXECUTED, not FAIL_SOURCE or PASS
Z8: never turn a private repo public to reduce bills without independent owner authority
Z9: Work only if essential; present Chat continuation and optimized bounded Work prompt, with stop and token-budget limits
Z10: each checkpoint has one actionable product-goal Next Action; do not loop on the same unchanged blocker
